subject.title: [Bug]: 401 The API key format is incorrect

question: How should OpenClaw treat Volcengine Lite/CodingPlan UUID-like keys when the selected model is a general `volcengine/*` model such as `volcengine/deepseek-v3-2-251201`?
rationale: The source shows a real split between general and CodingPlan endpoints, but only a credentialed Volcengine check can decide whether the correct product behavior is rerouting, clearer diagnostics, or shared-key support.

options.title: Validate Lite routing first
options.body: Run a redacted live check against both Volcengine endpoints and implement the narrow provider behavior that matches the vendor result.

options.title: Keep Lite keys on CodingPlan
options.body: If Lite keys are only valid for `volcengine-plan`, keep standard models separate and add earlier setup/model-selection diagnostics for Lite-key users.

options.title: Support shared key on both endpoints
options.body: If Lite keys should work on both endpoints, treat the 401 as a runtime/auth bug and fix the credential/header path with regression coverage.

recommendation.title: Validate Lite routing first
recommendation.body: Run a redacted live check against both Volcengine endpoints and implement the narrow provider behavior that matches the vendor result.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history is on provider auth aliases, bundled provider manifests, and provider setup/runtime compatibility surfaces.
